title: Native F-GC49D registry Dummy-SWAP response seam and 50x1 A/B
purpose: Close the remaining same-registry A/B gap by running an analytic Dummy-SWAP response through the native F-GC49D 50-participant registry and application context, preserving the F-GC49D orchestration and MODFLOW strip while replacing only the leaf participant response in an explicitly test-only construction path.

authority_boundary.workstream: New F-GC-STRIP01 research slice; F-GC49D remains closed and canonically admitted behavior is not reopened.
authority_boundary.research_only_aquifer_storage_and_drain: Carry forward the C2D disjoint storage and MODFLOW DRN ownership declaration; this grants no production physical-storage or drain authority.
authority_boundary.design_gate: No implementation begins until the test-only participant seam and its transaction contract receive explicit interface review.

design_contract.replacement_boundary: Participant strategy only. The F-GC49D C API, native application context, participant registry lifecycle, 50 index-preserving handles, coupling iteration, MODFLOW6 6.8.0 application and native F-GC34 package publication remain the same as the matched real-SWAP control.
design_contract.construction: An explicit test-harness constructor or factory may bind the analytic provider. Production constructors continue to bind only the current real-SWAP participant. No environment-variable, global mutable switch, post-trial flux overwrite or test behavior reachable through the production entrypoint.
provider_operations: bind identity and immutable participant parameters
capture origin with tile, lineage, revision and time
evaluate a trial at the prescribed interface head and return a self-consistent candidate plus q and response tangent
discard the complete candidate without changing committed state, revision, or ledger
preflight publication against the exact origin and coupling window
commit candidate and participant revision exactly once after accepted MODFLOW finalization
report identity and candidate/publication readiness to the unchanged registry/context orchestration
design_contract.candidate_identity: Every candidate is bound to its participant id, origin lineage/revision, t0/t1 and prescribed head. Stale, mismatched, duplicate, or already-consumed candidates fail closed.
design_contract.dummy_physics: Use the C2D memoryless linear storage and prescribed finite-resistance response equations, with all 50 identical initial states and the existing 1:1 cell mapping. Candidate storage, reported q and tangent must derive from the same analytic trial; no flux may be substituted after trial evaluation.
design_contract.ownership: Dummy owns its declared top-system storage and recharge. MODFLOW owns its disjoint research aquifer storage and the only DRN. Interface exchange is internal action/reaction. Complete-domain balance remains input minus dummy storage change minus MODFLOW storage change minus drain minus residual equals zero.
design_contract.publication_order: Retain the admitted F-GC49D preflight and irreversible publication ordering; rejected candidates publish neither MODFLOW state nor participant state/revision/ledger. The research provider must not own or bypass the native MODFLOW lifecycle.

qualification_sequence.case: 50 identical -1 m heads and dummy states; four 0.25-day windows; zero forcing and zero exchange.
qualification_sequence.gate: All windows publish; no state drift, drain or mass residual; each native registry identity/revision and ledger count advances once per accepted window; two fresh-process result records are byte-identical.

qualification_sequence.case: Inject one deterministic participant rejection before irreversible publication in a 50-participant window.
qualification_sequence.gate: No participant committed state, revision or ledger changes; no MODFLOW finalize/publication occurs; all candidates are discarded; the next clean retry starts from the same origin and publishes once.

qualification_sequence.case: C2D-aligned 80 x 0.25-day uniform 0.001 m/day recharge windows followed by 40 x 0.25-day recession windows; run near-zero resistance and C=0.125 m2/day.
qualification_sequence.gate: All 120 windows publish; positive interface transfer, spatial head mound toward the right no-flow edge, lateral flow and left-drain discharge are measured; internal and interface heads differ for finite resistance; response law, action/reaction and per-window/cumulative complete-domain balances close.

qualification_sequence.case: Run matched real-SWAP C2B and Dummy-SWAP trajectories through the same native registry/context/MODFLOW harness and record source manifests.
qualification_sequence.gate: Identify the first divergent subsystem and classify the outcome as native coupling/topology failure, real-SWAP/Richards-side blocker supported, or numerically blocked with a measured cause. Fresh-process replay is exact for each deterministic case.

separate_metrics: coupling iteration count and flux residual in m/s
dummy, MODFLOW and complete-domain mass residuals per window and cumulative
head profiles, 49 lateral face flows, interface fluxes and native DRN budget
diagnostics_and_gates.tolerance_policy: Start from C2D validated criteria and distinguish solver, coupling and physical mass gates. Any stricter or looser gate is preregistered with dimensional and measured justification; no production tolerance changes.
diagnostics_and_gates.source_identity: Persist exact source commit/blob manifest, compiler/profile, MODFLOW6 and XMI/FloPy identities, input configuration, run command, raw compact result and replay identity.

invariants_review.expected_effect: The research seam may exercise the existing coupling boundary but must preserve candidate/committed separation, conservation and production real-SWAP defaults. It does not alter admitted physical equations or ownership.
invariants_review.open_risk: Current registry and participant use concrete Fortran types. A generic provider may require a shared interface refactor; if review concludes that this cannot be done additively with unchanged production behavior, stop and keep C2D as the bounded service/MODFLOW reference rather than weakening the contract.

acceptance_deliverables: native zero, rejection, dynamic, finite-resistance and matched A/B results
bounded conclusion and updated STRIP01 status record
prohibited_shortcuts: overwriting q after a real Richards trial
encoding dummy storage in unrelated SWAP physical fields
changing canonical F-GC49D defaults, ABI semantics, production tolerances, retry policy or fixed-interface ownership
using a separate registry or Python service and describing it as the same-registry A/B
counting interface exchange as external input or physical storage
next_action: Review the provider interface against F-GC49D context ownership and publication ordering. If accepted, implement the seam behind an explicit native test-only factory, then run the preregistered qualification sequence.
